correctness.rationale: Adapt an orthonormal basis to simultaneously diagonalize horizontal and central Gram matrices; let p=|X|²,q=|Y|². On H-type horizontal four-space the maps j(z)x span x-perp isometrically, giving |[X,Y]|²=pq. Bounding two mixed terms in the source curvature expression gives K≤F=(p+q)/4−5pq/4+(3/2)√(pq(1−p)(1−q)). With u=√pq and v=√((1−p)(1−q)), u+v≤1 and 4F=1−4u²−v²+6uv≤16/11, equality uniquely u=4/11,v=7/11 hence p=q=4/11. Equality in both mixed inner products is precisely j(z)y=j(w)x and j(z)x=−j(w)y; conversely these conditions attain 4/11. Independently verified Clifford matrices from all six brackets and exact parabola maximum; finite checker alone was not used as a proof.
